# AdCreator

> AI ad creator for Indian small businesses. Drop a product photo, pick a language, get three studio-quality ad creatives in 30 seconds — copy written natively in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, or English; background removed; composited onto a brand-perfect template.

The product is a Next.js app that runs Fabric.js client-side for canvas rendering, Groq for ad-copy generation in 4 Indian languages, HuggingFace RMBG-1.4 for background removal, Cloudflare R2 for image storage, and Razorpay for INR billing. Code is open at https://github.com/DurgeshKr2242/makemyadd.
